name: Regem
title: Descendant of Caleb
summary: Regem is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Caleb through his concubine Maaka. He is known primarily for his place in Caleb's genealogy and has no prominent role in the biblical narrative beyond this.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Caleb's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Regem is mentioned as one of the sons of Jahdai in the genealogy of Caleb, a prominent figure in the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Father of Regem-Melek
keyEvents.description: Regem is recorded as the father of Regem-Melek (also called Jotham in some translations), who continued the lineage.

keyEvents.title: Part of Caleb's extended family
keyEvents.description: Regem belonged to the extended family of Caleb, son of Hezron, which was an important lineage in the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Maakah, Caleb's concubine
keyEvents.description: Regem is part of that branch of Caleb's family that came through his concubine Maakah, who bore several sons and descendants.
